verdict.rationale: Custom frameworks and controls are a fair axis for a compliance automation platform, but the evidence pack never documents creating a custom framework, custom controls, custom tests, or evidence requirements. It only mentions built-in, pre-mapped controls and supported frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS). Adjacent items such as AI-system custom fields, ingestion webhooks, and custom integration push APIs are building blocks or related features, not this capability.
